mainFinding: Verified downloadable 2019 state-nominated 491 invitation records with six-digit occupation, invitation date and reported Subclass Score, suitable only for a separately dated historical archive. No recent 2023–2026 complete state×occupation×invitation count×score event table located in the bounded public search. This is a search limit, not proof no such publication exists.
countDefinition: Number of published primary-applicant EOI invitation rows. Not unique individuals, not family members, not visa grants. Repeated otherwise-identical rows are retained because each is a separate released row; no deduplication on occupation/date/points.
pointsDefinition: PDF column is Subclass Score. Preserve reported values (65–100 among 491 rows). Inclusion of nomination bonus points is not explicitly defined here. Aggregated minimum is derived for this source cohort; not an official current minimum threshold.
residenceDefinition: Country of Residence as reported; not proof of physical applicant location at invitation. Null English values are preserved.
suppression: No count cells are suppressed in this individual-row release. No inferred zeros for state/occupation combinations absent from records.
